title: Hardening: expanded neutrality red-team, WCAG 2.2 AA + plain-language, reconciliation/reproducibility verification + partner runbook
context: Before the project can be handed to a distribution partner, it must be hardened for real readers and real-world use. This means expanding the neutrality red-team suite (including insider-misuse vectors), verifying WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility and plain-language reading-level targets, confirming end-to-end reproducibility (regenerate identically from snapshot checksum and template version), and producing a partner onboarding and handoff runbook. Depends on neutrality-003, reconcile-007, and publish-014.
objective: Harden the project for partner readiness: expand the neutrality red-team suite (100% pass including insider-misuse vectors), verify WCAG 2.2 AA and plain-language reading-level compliance on core explainers, confirm end-to-end reconciliation and reproducibility (re-run yields byte/figure-identical output from snapshot checksum + template version), and write the partner onboarding/handoff runbook.
acceptanceCriteria: Expanded neutrality red-team suite still achieves 100% pass/redirect; insider-misuse vectors (framing smuggling, editorializing-by-citation-choice, comparison gaming, allegation-by-implication) are all covered with regression cases
Core pilot jurisdiction explainers meet WCAG 2.2 AA accessibility requirements verified by an accessibility audit
Core pilot jurisdiction explainers meet the plain-language reading-level target verified by a readability scorer
End-to-end reproducibility verified: regenerating explainers from the same snapshot checksum and template version produces byte/figure-identical output
Partner onboarding and handoff runbook written: covers deploy, source re-ingest, snapshot re-verification, and partner support
Reviewed and signed off by the neutrality reviewer and maintainer; PR merged with green CI
output: A merged PR containing the expanded neutrality red-team suite, accessibility and readability verification results, end-to-end reproducibility confirmation, and partner onboarding/handoff runbook — completing M4 partner-readiness hardening.
